title: Keep a local value
summary: Lua: Keep a local value. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: local limits a name to its part of the program. This helps avoid accidental global names.
learningObjectives: Keep a local value with Lua

blocks.text: Install Lua 5.3 or 5.4. Save each example as lesson.lua and run lua lesson.lua.
local limits the name to this scope. Adding 2 to its value 3 gives 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use local unless a name really needs to be global.
